parameters.help_en:
The idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References: How to ensure idempotence (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)
parameters.help_zh:
幂等Token，保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《如何保证幂等性 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The credential provider name.

The name cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
凭据提供商名称。

长度不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: credential_provider_name

fields.help_en:
The client_secret in the OAuth protocol.

The value cannot exceed 1024 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
对应OAuth协议中的client_secret，客户端密钥。

长度不能超过1024个字符
fields.name: client_secret

fields.help_en:
The token endpoint of the OAuth protocol.

The value must start with `http://` or `https://` and cannot exceed 1024 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
对应OAuth协议的Token端点。

必须以`http://`或`https://`开头，且长度不能超过1024个字符
fields.name: token_endpoint

fields.help_en:
The scope in the OAuth protocol, which specifies the permission scope.

The Scope configuration on the OAuth credential provider serves as a fallback value. If the scope parameter is not specified when calling the DeveloperAPI to obtain an OAuth Access Token, the Scope configuration on the credential provider is used for token issuance.

<notice>Separate multiple Scope values with spaces. To clear the Scope configuration, pass an empty string.></notice>

Restrictions for each individual Scope value:
Allowed characters: lowercase letters, digits, and special characters `|/:_-.`
Must contain at least one lowercase letter or digit.
Must start with a special character `.`, a lowercase letter, or a digit.
Cannot exceed 1024 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
对应OAuth协议中的scope，权限范围。

OAuth凭据提供商处的Scope配置将作为兜底值，若在调用DeveloperAPI获取OAuth Access Token时不指定scope参数，则会以凭据提供商处的Scope配置为准进行签发。

<notice>多个Scope值之间使用空格分隔。若需要置空Scope配置，填入空字符串即可。></notice>

对单个Scope值的限制如下：
允许的字符：小写英文字母、数字、特殊字符`|/:_-.`
且必须包含小写英文字母或数字
必须以特殊字符`.`或小写英文字母或数字开头
长度不超过1024个字符
fields.name: scope

fields.help_en:
The OAuth authorization flow type. Valid values:
m2m: Machine-to-machine (2LO, Client Credentials).
user_federation: User federation (3LO, Authorization Code)
fields.help_zh: OAuth的具体授权类型。m2m: 机器对机器(2LO, Client Credentials)；user_federation: 用户联邦(3LO, Authorization Code)
fields.name: authorization_flow

fields.help_en: The endpoint URL used to guide users through authorization. Conditionally required: this parameter is required when AuthorizationFlow is set to user_federation and ProviderVendor is set to custom. For preset vendors, this value can be automatically populated through DiscoveryUrl
fields.help_zh: 用于引导用户进行授权的端点地址。条件必填：当AuthorizationFlow=user_federation且ProviderVendor=custom时必填；预置厂商可通过DiscoveryUrl自动填充
fields.name: authorization_endpoint

fields.help_en: The preset vendor or custom configuration. This parameter is optional. Default value: custom
fields.help_zh: 预置厂商或自定义配置。非必填，默认值：custom
fields.name: provider_vendor

fields.help_en: The Discovery document URL used to automatically retrieve OAuth endpoint configurations. Conditionally optional: this parameter is used when AuthorizationFlow is set to user_federation. If DiscoveryUrl is not provided, you must manually configure fields such as TokenEndpoint and AuthorizationEndpoint
fields.help_zh: 用于自动获取OAuth端点配置的Discovery文档地址。条件可选：当AuthorizationFlow=user_federation时使用，如不提供DiscoveryUrl，则需手动配置TokenEndpoint、AuthorizationEndpoint等字段
fields.name: discovery_url

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to use the PKCE extension for enhanced security. We recommend that you always enable this feature
fields.help_zh: 是否使用PKCE扩展增强安全性，推荐始终启用
fields.name: pkce_enabled

fields.help_en: The PKCE code_challenge generation method. Default value: s256
fields.help_zh: PKCE code_challenge 生成方法。默认s256
fields.name: pkce_challenge_method

fields.help_en: The configuration of the OAuth credential provider
fields.help_zh: OAuth 类型的凭据提供商配置
fields.name: oauth_provider_config

fields.help_en: The validity period of the JWT, in seconds
fields.help_zh: JWT 的有效时长，单位秒
fields.name: expiration

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable JWT expiration cleanup
fields.name: expiration_cleanup_enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the JWT derived short token capability
fields.help_zh: 是否开启JWT派生短令牌能力
fields.name: derived_short_token_enabled

fields.help_en:
The list of allowed JWT issuers.

The list cannot contain more than 200 entries.

<notice>To clear the issuer list, pass an empty list or an empty string when calling the API.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
允许的JWT的issuer列表。

列表长度不超过200。

<notice>若需要置空Issuer列表，调用时传入空列表或者空字符串></notice>
fields.name: allowed_token_issuers

fields.help_en: The configuration of the JWT credential provider
fields.help_zh: JWT 类型的凭据提供商配置
fields.name: jwt_provider_config
